WITH telescope_weather_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.telescref,
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY s.telescref, o.weathprofile
),
above_mean_groups AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS mean_group_avg_modindex
  FROM telescope_weather_averages
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM above_mean_groups
  WHERE avg_modindex > mean_group_avg_modindex
)
SELECT
  weathprofile,
  AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
  AVG(avg_phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg,
  AVG(avg_modindex - mean_group_avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex_above_baseline
FROM kept_groups
GROUP BY weathprofile;
